name: delay_slapback_guitar
description: Slapback echo on guitar — classic Sun Studios / rockabilly character
notes: 100ms single echo at mix 0.3. LP at 6kHz darkens the echo so it sits behind the dry signal, loosely in the spirit of tape echo units (no tape modelling: no wow/flutter or saturation). No feedback keeps it tight. Works on both clean and lightly driven guitar. For a more modern double-tracked feel, try 20-30ms at mix 0.5 instead.
